Forget a node's registration.

For a decommissioned node, a renamed host that left a record behind, or a
third Grid pointed at this working directory by mistake. A node that is
still running re-registers within 30 seconds — which is the honest outcome:
a live member cannot be removed by deleting a file, and the roster should
say so rather than pretend.
